nested-workspace: nested replacement, literal content, emptying and final teardown
filter-projects: filter/reveal preserves domain data and row identity
rank-projects: valid reorder preserves edited DOM and invalid reorder is atomic
save-shortcut: shortcut is host scoped and released across rerender/destroy
connection-status: provider subscription survives rerender and is released once
overlay-switch: only Views enter Region and invalid open preserves current overlay
overlay-dismiss: exclusive overlays release dismissal listeners on every public empty path
async-panel: out-of-order completion, stop, failures and destroy are deterministic
async-session: stale provider acquisition and active subscription both release resources
scoped-message-presenter: independent evented presenters release only owned subscriptions
owned-workspace-state: owned state survives deferred Application restart and session cleanup
borrowed-workspace-state: borrowed state survives deferred Application restart and canceled destroy
composed-lifecycle-repair: working startup, edits, refresh errors and repeated resource cycles survive repair
canceled loading never validates or commits its late value
late validation cannot overwrite a newer successful start
refresh replacement, obsolete errors and successful stop invalidate pending work
rejected stop preserves delivery, heartbeat, editing and pending refresh
destroy adopts stop permission and prevents late refresh commits
startup validation failure preserves data and acquires no resources
borrowed source survives destruction for another consumer
refresh validation errors respect replacement and preserve data for retry
start superseding pending stop releases the previous resource pair
